sources.title: Whisper-Large-V3-Turbo - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Whisper-Large-V3-Turbo Transformer‑based automatic speech recognition (ASR) model for multilingual transcription and translation available on HuggingFace. Whisper large‑v3‑turbo is a finetuned version of a pruned Whisper large‑v3. In other words, it's the exact same model, except that the number of decoding layers have reduced from 32 to 4.
